meta.title: Jacek Janczura — Founder-CTO · Enterprise AI
meta.description: Founder-CTO working on enterprise AI. Co-founded Jaden Data and led it as CTO to €1M+ annual revenue and a ten-person engineering team; fractional CTO and consulting partner since 2024. Production AI for APG, Bosch Global Services, KfW and Boehringer Ingelheim; distributed systems for Norges Bank and ING.

I work from executive discovery and technical pre-sales through architecture, code, production rollout and handover.
